name: RL Hudson

about:
RL Hudson was founded in 1980 in Tulsa, Oklahoma, as a distributor of rubber O-rings to the regional oil industry. The company expanded nationally by 1985, added an in-house engineering department in 1991, and began manufacturing mandrel-formed hoses in 1996. Plastic injection molding capabilities were added in 1999, and operations relocated to Broken Arrow, Oklahoma, in 2004. Leadership includes Chairman Rick Hudson and CEO Jason Hudson.

The company specializes in custom plastic injection molding, rubber component manufacturing, and value-added unit assembly. Its plastic molding uses scientific (decoupled) injection molding on presses from 85 to 4,000 tons with real-time AuthenTIG monitoring. Rubber capabilities include injection, transfer, and compression molding, plus wrapped and extruded formed hoses. In-house tooling design, machining, and maintenance support production, while plastic welding covers ultrasonic, spin, hot-plate, and vibration methods. A 2024 expansion added a high-volume automated assembly line.

RL Hudson serves OEMs across automotive, HVAC, medium and heavy trucks, outdoor power equipment, powersports, agriculture, appliances, marine, power generation, waterworks, heavy equipment, material handling, and on-highway engine industries. Customers include material handling OEMs, outdoor power equipment manufacturers, and on-highway engine makers who rely on the firm for part consolidation, metal-to-plastic conversions, and complex multi-component assemblies.

The company emphasizes end-to-end solutions, combining design engineering, error-proofing, and rigorous quality control under one roof. Its integrated molding and assembly model aims to deliver faster turnaround, tighter quality control, and cost-effective part consolidation with a zero-defect mentality. Certifications include ISO 9001, ISO 14001, and IATF 16949.
